name: Antagonistic Dual-Wavelength TVAM
definition: A TVAM variant that suppresses tomographic background dose by combining a patterned activation field (405 nm) with a separately optimised inhibition field (365 nm) that suppresses polymerisation where activation is not wanted.
summary: Antagonistic Dual-Wavelength TVAM is a volumetric additive manufacturing integrator that suppresses tomographic background dose by combining a 405 nm activation field with a 365 nm inhibition field to mitigate diffusion-driven loss of spatial fidelity.
